div.div:
Legend
Filled arrow: caller → callee. Normal responses are folded into request labels.
A (blue): write / metadata sync — publish content and metadata events, poll, upsert.
B (orange): read / retrieval — query metadata, retrieve S3 content, save once, return blob reference.
Solid: main call (including async publication). Dashed: auxiliary query B1. A/B numbering is independent.
Cosmos DB stores metadata; S3 and temporary Blob Storage hold document content.

text.tspan: Filled arrow: caller → callee. Normal responses are folded into request labels.
A (blue): write / metadata sync — publish content and metadata events, poll, upsert.
B (orange): read / retrieval — query metadata, retrieve S3 content, save once, return blob reference.
Solid: main call (including async publication). Dashed: auxiliary query B1. A/B numbering is independent.
Cosmos DB stores metadata; S3 and temporary Blob Storage hold document content.
